Product Brief - Widget 2.0

Prepared by Product Management · Classification: internal

Executive summary

Widget 2.0 replaces the 1.x line with a fully modular architecture. The core module is 40 % lighter, the interface module is swappable in the field, and the service interval doubled to 24 months.

Pricing for the entry configuration is unchanged. The premium configuration adds the telemetry module and a five-year warranty.

Key numbers

Weight: 12.4 kg (was 20.1 kg)
Service interval: 24 months
MTBF: 18,000 h
Warranty: 2 years standard

All figures validated by the engineering review of 2024-08-01, revision C.
